description: Platform RBAC seed policy derived from the headless API operation permission contract.

standard_roles.viewer: Read-only access to provider status, results, artifacts, reports, and outputs.
standard_roles.operator: Can monitor provider state and submit or stop measurement jobs.
standard_roles.report_manager: Can read provider state and control report automation.
standard_roles.admin: Platform administrator; provider adapter treats admin as a super-permission.

rules: Operation permissions are generated from the API contract and must not be duplicated by hand.
Non-admin roles grant only operation permissions.
The admin role grants the admin super-permission.
Token validation, user login, sessions, and IdP integration belong to the future platform backend.
